newsitem.title: USA: Logan's Roadhouse registers 1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Logan's Roadhouse registers 1 mln shares.

text.p: Logan's Roadhouse Inc filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register an offering of up to one million common shares.
Underwriters for the offering, J.C. Bradford & Co Equitable Securities Corp, have an over-allotment option of up to 150,000 shares.
The Nashville-based restaurant chain owner said proceeds from the sale will be used to develop more restaurants and improve currently owned restaurants.
After the offering, the company will have 7,016,659 shares outstanding, according to the SEC filing.
